business_summary: Boralex Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the developing, building, and operating power generating and storage facilities in Canada, France, the United States, and the United Kingdom. The company generates electricity from wind, solar, and hydroelectric resources. As of December 31, 2025, the company operates 107 wind farms; 13 solar power stations; 15 hydroelectric power stations; and 4 battery energy storage systems with an installed capacity of 2,299 megawatts (MW) in North America and 1,484 MW in Europe. Boralex Inc. was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Kingsey Falls, Canada.
